messages:
jess: Ugh my wifi keeps dropping every ~10 mins, ISP says maintenance but only my unit? 62c anyone else on my floor seeing this?
emily: not me, working fine from apt 6A.
owen: Try rebooting the mesh nodes first. sometimes they lock up after firmware updates.
maya: also try renewing DHCP: `ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew` on windows or toggle wifi on mac.
jess: on mac, trying the toggle now, tethered to phone in the meantime.
trent: Pro-tip: if you're hotspotting, force 2.4GHz for better range, and turn off auto-connect on other devices.
jess: (image: speedtest-hotspot-1.png) 3 Mbps down when it drops 631
nick: I have a spare travel router (TL-WR902) I can drop off if you want stable AP while landlord troubleshoots. DM me buzzer code.
emily: Also scan for crowded channels, switch to 1/6/11 depending on noise. baby monitors and garage openers are wildcards.
sam: sometimes unplugging the nodes for 30s and powering back helps.
jess: ipad wifi analyzer showing crowd on channel 6 :face_with_thermometer:
lia: Poll (react): Backup for meetings? Add :iphone: for mobile tether, :router: for travel router, :coffee: for coffee shop fallback.
owen: (reacts with :router:)
security-bot: Reminder: Do not post passwords in public channels. Share network creds via DM or via the secure ticket system.
jess: thx @nick, DMing you now 49c
trent: If you're on Zoom a lot, enable "low bandwidth" mode and avoid HD video during hotspot. Settings > Bandwidth > Optimize for low bandwidth.
jess: landlord's tech just fixed a loose splitter outside, back to ~80 Mbps. you're all lifesavers. (gif: party parrot)
